newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Grajewo sets registering period Jan 20-24.
newsitem.headline: Polish Grajewo sets registering period Jan 20-24.

text.p: Polish wood panel producer Zaklady Plyt Wiorowych w Grajewie SA (Grajewo) has set its new registration period of its initial public offering of 550,000 shares for January 20-24, its president said on Monday.
"We chose January because of marketing reasons, we believe it is better climate for investing in shares," Jan Kowalski told Reuters.
The company initially planned to carry out the issue in December.
Kowalski said that in the large buyers' tranche investors can subscribe for 260,000 shares from January 20-21 and in the small investor tranche of 90,000 shares they can register from January 20-24.
Kowalski said the closed tranche of 200,000 earmarked for current shareholders would be held between January 20 and 24.

The firm's shareholders are National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 15 in Poland's mass privatisation programme, with 33 percent, 27 percent is held by other 14 NFIs, state treasury with 25 percent and employees holding 15 percent.
Grajewo, which seeks a main market's listing, made a net profit of 12.4 million zlotys last year on sales of 195.7 million zlotys.
